title: Service Revenue
meaning: Income generated from services rendered, such as laboratory tests, medical consultations, and diagnostics.

title: Accumulated Depreciation
meaning: Total reduction in the value of fixed assets (e.g., medical equipment, office tools) due to wear and tear over time.

title: Accounts Receivable
meaning: Amounts owed by clients for services provided on credit.

title: Notes Receivable
meaning: Formal promissory notes from clients promising future payment.

title: Accounts Payable
meaning: Outstanding obligations to suppliers and service providers, including purchased medical supplies or outsourced services.

title: Notes Payable
meaning: Formal loan agreements or promissory notes for business financing, such as bank loans or equipment installment payments.

title: Professional Fees Payable
meaning: Compensation owed to licensed professionals, such as doctors and medical technologists, for their services.

title: Salaries Expenses
meaning: Unpaid salaries of employees within a payroll period.

title: Backpay
meaning: Final compensation given to a separated employee, including remaining salary, prorated benefits, and any applicable deductions.

title: Utilities Expense - Water
meaning: Costs related to water consumption in business operations.

title: Utilities Expense - Electricity
meaning: Electricity expenses incurred for business operations.

title: Utilities Expense - Telephone
meaning: Costs associated with telephone and communication services.

title: Utilities Expense - Wi-Fi & Internet Services
meaning: Expenses related to broadband, Wi-Fi, and mobile data plans for business operations.

title: Rental Expense
meaning: Payments for leased office, laboratory, or clinic space.

title: Taxes and Licenses Expense
meaning: Government fees for business permits, licenses, and taxation.

title: Transportation Expense
meaning: Travel costs related to business activities, including employee transport allowances.

title: Representation and Entertainment Expense
meaning: Expenses for meals, meetings, and entertainment during business events, client visits, or sponsorships.

title: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts
meaning: Expected losses from unpaid receivables due to customer defaults.

title: Insurance Expense
meaning: Premium payments for business-related insurance, such as property, liability, or health coverage.

title: Miscellaneous Expense
meaning: Minor business expenses that do not fall under other specific categories.

title: Outsourcing Expense
meaning: Payments to third-party service providers, such as contract healthcare workers or administrative support.

title: Medical Supplies Expense
meaning: Costs of medical and laboratory supplies consumed in operations.

title: Charitable Contributions and Donations
meaning: Monetary or in-kind donations for community projects or outreach programs.

title: Sales Commissions Expense
meaning: Payments for commissions earned from sales or services provided to clients.

title: Capital
meaning: Initial investment in the business or project.

title: Retained Earnings
meaning: Accumulated profit or loss from previous years.

title: Capital Withdrawals
meaning: Money withdrawn from the business or project.

title: Capital Deposits
meaning: Money deposited into the business or project.

title: Partial remittances
meaning: Partial remittance of the daily sales.

title: Clearance Pay
meaning: The final compensation given to an employee after completing the clearance process upon resignation, end of contract, or termination. It includes unpaid salary, prorated 13th month pay, convertible leave credits, and other benefits minus any deductions.

title: Sales Discount
meaning: Reductions from gross sales due to agreed discounts with HMOs or institutions.

title: GCash Discount
meaning: Transaction fees or deductions applied by GCash per sale.

title: Sales from Branch Sendout
meaning: Revenues collected from other branches sending laboratory test requests.

title: Sales - Care Of MD
meaning: Payments made by doctors for services rendered to their patients.

title: Sales - Care Of Entities
meaning: Revenues received from corporate clients such as Coca-Cola or San Miguel.

title: Miscellaneous Income
meaning: Extra income from overpayments, unclaimed deposits, or unclassified small revenues.

title: Bank Interest Income
meaning: Interest earned from bank deposits or time deposit accounts.

title: Donation Income
meaning: Non-obligatory gifts received by the company, typically from suppliers during holidays.

title: Rental Income
meaning: Income generated from renting out laboratory or clinic space and assets.

title: Retainer’s Fee
meaning: Fixed periodic professional fee paid to external consultants such as legal, accounting, or medical specialists.

title: Rebates to MD
meaning: Percentage of service revenue given as rebate or incentive to referring physicians.

title: Rebates to Entity
meaning: Sales rebates given to partner organizations like SMB, Coke, or Cosmos.

title: Preventive Maintenance
meaning: Expenses allocated for preventive upkeep of machines, saving future repair costs.

title: Bank Service Charge
meaning: Bank fees charged for deposits, fund transfers, or checkbook issuance.

title: Printing Fee
meaning: Expenses for printed materials, patient records, ID cards, or document papers.

title: SSS, Pag-IBIG, PhilHealth – Employer Share
meaning: Employer's mandatory share in government contributions for Social Security System, Pag-IBIG, and PhilHealth.

title: 13th Month Pay
meaning: Mandatory bonus equivalent to one twelfth (1/12) of an employee's annual basic salary.

title: 14th Month Pay
meaning: Additional company bonus given as part of incentive or performance reward, non-mandatory.

title: Meal Allowance
meaning: Daily allowance granted to employees for meal expenses during duty hours.

title: Rice Incentive
meaning: Monthly benefit in the form of rice or equivalent cash incentive for employees.

title: Travel Allowance
meaning: Allowance given to staff for work-related travel or branch visits.

title: Motor Allowance
meaning: Allowance for employees using motorcycles for official business travel.

title: Communication Allowance
meaning: Monthly stipend given to staff for mobile/data expenses used in official communications.

title: Cost of Living Allowance (COLA)
meaning: Legally mandated allowance provided to adjust for inflation and cost of living.

title: Reliever’s Fee
meaning: Compensation paid to temporary workers or substitutes filling in for regular staff.

title: BIR 1601-E
meaning: Monthly remittance of withholding tax on income payments subject to expanded withholding tax.

title: BIR 1702Q
meaning: Quarterly income tax return for corporations and partnerships.

title: BIR 1702 - Income Tax Expense
meaning: Annual income tax due as computed by third-party accountants.

title: Expanded Withholding Tax
meaning: Tax withheld from professional services or rentals, typically at 2%.

title: Miscellaneous Tax
meaning: Other minor taxes such as documentary stamps or special fees not categorized elsewhere.

title: Honorarium
meaning: Non-salary compensation given for voluntary or special professional services.

title: Honorarium – Admin
meaning: Honorarium granted to administrative staff or executives for special assignments.

title: Bonus
meaning: Company-wide reward given during holidays or based on overall performance.

title: Incentive Fee
meaning: Performance-based financial reward given to employees, includes home service commissions.

title: Incentive Fee – Admin
meaning: Incentive or bonus specifically for administrative personnel.

title: Seminar/Training/Convention
meaning: Registration fees and participation costs for professional seminars, conventions, or industry trainings.

title: Seminar Allowance
meaning: Allowance or stipend granted to employees attending seminars or trainings.

title: Membership/Participation Fee
meaning: Annual or event-based fees paid for membership in professional associations (e.g. PAMET, NEQAS).

title: Registration Expense
meaning: Expenses related to business registrations such as Mayor’s Permit or SEC filings.

title: Permits and Licenses
meaning: Government-imposed fees for regulatory compliance such as DOH, DENR, and HAZWASTE permits.

title: Birthday Allowance
meaning: Special one-time allowance or gift given to employees on their birthdays.

title: Farewell Gift/Token
meaning: Parting gifts or farewell tokens given to retiring or resigning staff members.

title: Certification Fee
meaning: Fees for professional certifications or renewals required by staff (e.g. HIV counselor, PCO officer).

title: License Fee
meaning: Annual license renewal fees for medical professionals, such as doctors and radiologic technologists.

title: Notarial Fee
meaning: Payments for notarization of contracts, affidavits, and other legal documents.

title: Repairs and Maintenance
meaning: Expenses for repairing and maintaining equipment, utilities, and facility infrastructure.

title: Clothing and Uniform
meaning: Cost of uniforms, ID cards, or other apparel required for staff.

title: Delivery Expense
meaning: Courier or delivery costs for supplies, large equipment, or documents (e.g., via Lalamove, Grab).

title: Gas Expense
meaning: Fuel expenses for official business-related transport.

title: Marketing Fee
meaning: Fixed marketing service cost, such as agency fees or promotional partnerships.

title: Advertising Expense
meaning: Expenses for paid advertising, such as Facebook ads, tarpaulins, or flyers.

title: Appearance Fee
meaning: Honorarium given to professionals (e.g. legal) for presence in meetings, hearings, or special appearances.

title: Pharmacy Expense
meaning: Purchases of pharmaceutical products or supplies used internally.

title: Commission Expense
meaning: Compensation based on percentage of sales or service, excluding regular staff bonuses.

title: Other Expense
meaning: Miscellaneous business-related costs not categorized elsewhere.

title: Service Fee
meaning: Charges paid to third-party service providers (e.g., guards, outsourced accountants).
